Headlines carry no trailing punctuation and titles/paragraphs do, exactly as the sidecars specify (org.plan_headline, org.no_access_headline, org.that_organization bare; empty.*.title and org.*_body with 。). Button labels clear.filter / clear.search carry no punctuation.
